stem.en: Compare three microscopic arrangements: long parallel fibres, tapering spindle-shaped cells and short branching cells.

text.en: Long parallel fibres are best suited to shortening strongly in one main direction to pull skeletal levers across joints.
Tapering spindle-shaped cells are better suited to squeezing the wall of a hollow organ.
Short branching cells are best suited to pulling skeletal levers because branching increases strength.

explanation.en: Use structure, not memorisation, to justify your decision.
